audit.whatIsWrong: diff is 'EVEN' but diffRating is '8/10' with a red tone and 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' in two prose fields. The win rate is 59.93% — the second-strongest matchup in this slice — and the packet gives Garen five of seven stages.
audit.why: Same rating-block defect as the Swain and Teemo entries. A lane Garen wins at 59.93% is not an 8/10.
audit.corrected: diff FAV, diffRating 3.5/10, green tone, and both difficulty strings rewritten. carryRating left at 8.5/10 because breakdown.carry already agrees with it — Trundle really is a high-threat duelist late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer has win[0] through win[6] ALL set to 'Trundle' — seven identical rows, so the level chart conveys nothing. The full layer gives Trundle every stage too, with ratings of 2/10 and 3/10. The packet is Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Trundle, Garen, Trundle, and the page's own whys[] say so plainly: whys[0] 'You beat Trundle at level 1', whys[3] 'Levels 4-5 you keep the lead', whys[5] 'First item you swing back'.
audit.why: Trundle's early kit is a 3.5s bite and a terrain pillar; he has no burst and no gap-closer, and Garen's cost-free Q reset plus Judgment beats that outright. He genuinely takes Level 6 when Subjugate lands and the late game when his stat-steal and Frozen Domain compound. Those two rows the stored chart had right by accident.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Garen, Garen, Garen, Garen, Trundle, Garen, Trundle in both layers, proposed as one atomic group with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 and Late spikes described Subjugate as draining 'health and stats' and Frozen Domain as an 'attack-speed zone', without the specifics that change what the player buys.
audit.why: Subjugate steals a percent of health, ARMOUR and MAGIC RESIST, and the amount stolen doubles over the following 4 seconds — which is why the flagged missing interaction says raw resistances are the wrong answer: every point of armour Garen buys is partly a gift. Frozen Domain grants attack speed, move speed AND increased healing from all sources, which is what makes King's Tribute unmanageable without Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Both spikes rewritten with the real steal mechanics and the anti-heal requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate was listed at 80 seconds; that is its rank-3 value. Riot's cooldown is 120/100/80, so 120s at rank 1. And as the mirror found, the page names Garen's silence repeatedly and the slow-break not once: Trundle's only tools for holding Garen inside Frozen Domain are the Chomp slow and the Pillar of Ice slow, and Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows on a flat 8-second cooldown.
audit.why: The 80s figure makes a 120s ultimate look like a spell you can trade cooldowns with at level 6, which is the exact level the chart hands to Trundle. And the slow-break is the whole matchup: if slows do not hold Garen, Trundle's zoning game does not function, and the correct instruction is to walk in rather than to wait. The mirror independently identified the same omission.
audit.corrected: Subjugate restated at 120s rank 1 with the doubling steal; the slow-break written into tldr, spikes[0], early and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing explained why the standard Perseverance sustain plan fails here.
audit.why: Chomp is on a 3.5-second cooldown at every rank. Perseverance only regenerates when Garen has not recently been struck, so a Trundle who keeps biting keeps the passive switched off indefinitely. The mirror framed it the same way.

notes: IMPORTANT for the mirror reconciliation. The already-audited mirror trundle__garen deliberately left its level chart unchanged, recording that 'any rewrite of Trundle to Garen falls outside the applier's length band'. That belief is false — apply-proposals.js exempts win[N], phases[N].side and phases[N].rating as ENUM_FIELD and also skips strings under 25 characters, so these edits apply cleanly. I have therefore fixed the chart on this side. The mirror's chart will now disagree until it is corrected or mirror-fix.js reconciles it; the correct direction is the packet's (Garen 1-4, Trundle 6, Garen first item, Trundle 2+ items). The content layer here had all seven rows reading 'Trundle', which made the chart useless while the prose beside it argued the opposite.
